ambiguities_or_notes: Attributed material is translated from Tolstoy's compiled Russian wording rather than substituted from independent English editions.
всемирный разум is rendered conservatively as 'universal reason'; моток мира и его судеб as 'the skein of the world and its destinies'.
Tolstoy's contrast between temporal and eternal life and the repetition around what 'will be' are preserved rather than smoothed away.
